title: Digi Machine
author: Digital Alchemy DSP
description: A wavetable machine for the Digitone mk1 / Keys, OS 1.43, hosted on the synth tracks as extra SYN1 algorithm slots: a detunable wavetable oscillator with width (phase offset) and a morphable (linear-interpolated) oscillator. Selecting one of the added SYN1 algorithm slots (>= 8) starts the wavetable engine; the stock SYN/FILT/AMP pages are the interface. This Core A part uploads the wavetables and the engine image, engages the machine from the selected track's algorithm, pushes the parameters each block and injects the machine audio into the voice-mix source bus so the main FX process it. Stage 1: the FM voice for the slot is not skipped yet and per-note pitch is the SYN-page tune.
